alt: 客廳裡兩兄弟各抓住相簿一端爭執，長輩難過地坐在中間，牆上掛著全家福。
scene_prompt: Inside one family living room, two similar-looking adult brothers argue over one shared family photo album on a table, each angrily gripping one edge and pointing at the other; a framed family portrait behind them shows the SAME two brothers together with their parents, making shared family membership obvious. An elderly parent between them looks saddened. No physical injury or outside opponents.
